name: benefits-noise
text:
Payroll Administrator
Sudbury, ON | Hybrid (three days a week in office)
The hiring range is $68,500-$76,000 annually. We offer 15 days of vacation, a $1,500 wellness account and 4% RRSP match.
You bring 2+ years of payroll experience and your PCP designation.

name: no-numbers
text:
Graphic Designer
Join our friendly team in downtown Toronto. Salary commensurate with experience. Some experience with Adobe Creative Suite is required. Work location: in person.

name: french-optional-remote
text:
Technical Writer (Work from home)
Canada-wide. Pay: $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. Knowledge of French would be a nice bonus but is not necessary. At least 3 years writing API documentation.

name: weekly-onsite
text:
Line Cook
Hamilton, Ontario
Earn $900 a week. Work is on site at our restaurant. Weekends required. One year of kitchen experience needed.

name: head-office-trap
text:
Regional Sales Lead
Our head office is in Calgary, but this position is based in Kingston, Ontario.
Hybrid with one day per week in the office.
$105,000 - $125,000 a year. 8 years of sales leadership experience required. French is mandatory.
